request.prompt:
You are adjudicating possible duplicate records in a private professional network.

Decide only from the fields provided. Never infer facts that are not present.
Two people at the same company with similar names are DIFFERENT people unless an
identifier (email, linkedin) or a distinctive biographical detail links them.
A false merge is unrecoverable; a missed duplicate is not. When evidence is thin,
return insufficient_evidence.

For each numbered pair below, return one verdict object.

verdict must be exactly one of:
  same_person            an identifier or a distinctive detail links the two records
  different_people       the records contradict each other, or are merely similar
  insufficient_evidence  you cannot tell from what is here

confidence is 0.0 to 1.0.
reason is ONE sentence and must name the specific fields you used.

Respond with JSON only, in this shape:
{
  "$defs": {
    "PairVerdict": {
      "properties": {
        "pair_index": {
          "title": "Pair Index",
          "type": "integer"
        },
        "verdict": {
          "enum": [
            "same_person",
            "different_people",
            "insufficient_evidence"
          ],
          "title": "Verdict",
          "type": "string"
        },
        "confidence": {
          "maximum": 1.0,
          "minimum": 0.0,
          "title": "Confidence",
          "type": "number"
        },
        "reason": {
          "title": "Reason",
          "type": "string"
        }
      },
      "required": [
        "pair_index",
        "verdict",
        "confidence",
        "reason"
      ],
      "title": "PairVerdict",
      "type": "object"
    }
  },
  "properties": {
    "verdicts": {
      "items": {
        "$ref": "#/$defs/PairVerdict"
      },
      "title": "Verdicts",
      "type": "array"
    }
  },
  "required": [
    "verdicts"
  ],
  "title": "BatchVerdicts",
  "type": "object"
}

verdicts.reason: Matching name, location, company and identical bio link the records despite missing email/linkedin.
Different first names, emails, LinkedIn URLs and divergent bios indicate separate individuals.
First names differ and emails are distinct, showing they are different people.
Identical bio, same company and location with matching email domain confirm they are the same person.
Different first names, emails, titles and locations suggest they are different individuals.
Distinct first names and emails with no shared identifiers indicate different people.
Different first names and emails with no shared identifiers show they are different people.
